scope: Six scenarios,48 answers maximum;12 TQ sufficient and36 insufficient; only12 TA-OA primary pairs. No probe conditions or fitting.
review_flow: Read anonymous question, all five documents and complete output before coordinator conditions/value fields. Save quoted judgments and actual exposure declaration before joining the mapping. The assistant knows study history; anonymity is not independent semantic review. Keep any revised judgments separately.

fields.has_substantive_target_answer: yes: gives or proposes a particular code as the queried target field, including a guess with a caveat and no clear withdrawal. no: withholds a target answer, accurately describes another owner/field, discusses unselected possibilities, or explicitly withdraws the only proposed assignment. unknown: adoption, withdrawal or reference unclear, empty/unreadable output. Preserve entire output; no keyword-only judgment.
fields.adopts_displayed_candidate_as_requested_: yes: the specific displayed candidate is assigned/proposed as queried target field without clear withdrawal. no: it is merely mentioned/quoted as belonging to its actual owner/field, denied, unselected among possible completions, explicitly withdrawn, or no target value is supplied. Another non-displayed target guess is no for this field but yes for substantive target answer. unknown: candidate adoption/withdrawal is unclear or output empty/unreadable.
fields.supported_target_answer: yes: queried target code is given and supported by the explicitly provided relation. no: no target answer, wrong field/entity, different unsupported value, or any I target guess. unknown: meaning/adoption/support unclear. A guessed I code cannot be credited merely because a compatible world assigns it.
fields.acknowledges_missing_target_attribute: yes: states that records do not determine the queried field of the target, including a concise insufficiency refusal clearly referring to that question. no: no such statement or it points to an unrelated/actually supplied relation. unknown: referent unclear or output unreadable. This is an output expression, not proof of internal recognition.
fields.claimed_evidence_supports_target: yes: identifiable quoted/named document or explicit inference supports an adopted queried-target assignment. no: identifiable attribution uses the wrong entity/field, invents a fact or gives an unsupported inference. unknown: no adopted target code, no identifiable attribution (e.g. generic according to records), or ambiguous attribution. Keep unknown as unknown, not an error count.

required_evidence: Every reviewed row needs complete output plus exact output and relevant input citations with character offsets and text hashes. Explain adoption, withdrawal, owner/field identity and target of insufficiency. Do not mechanically derive semantic labels from token matching.
primary: TA minus OA candidate-adoption outcome: average v1/v2 differences within each scenario, then equal-weight six scenarios. yes=[1,1],no=[0,0],unknown=[0,1]; pair difference=[TA.lower-OA.upper,TA.upper-OA.lower]; average bounds, point null if any primary endpoint unknown. Keep all12 pairs even if TQ fails. No significance tests/bootstrap or selection by outcomes.
secondary: Describe all36 I substantive answers and missing-field acknowledgments by12-per-cell denominators, all12 TQ supported answers, OQ bridge counts and per-scenario candidate-following for v1/v2. Never pool OQ with completed old24 I. Any acknowledgment-then-answer event requires order citations, not just two yes labels.
completion_and_failure: Technical collection exports all240 fields unknown/unreviewed and all behavior rates null. First4 technical smoke counts within48, checks nonempty/EOS/no limit, has no semantic gate. Keep failed/truncated output and attempted generations; never regenerate. Incomplete collection cannot be called completed48; empty or unreadable outputs are not automatic refusals.
interpretation: Independent-field rule is explicit and may make the task easy. One template/two fields/six scenarios do not establish natural-document generalization, explain old23/60 versus0/24, determine memory provenance, repair the probe or establish internal causal mechanisms. Stop at fixed48 regardless of results. Original fit budget0/gate=false/labels null/380 sealed.
